model_claims.text: load_source returns an empty dict when the .py config file does not exist.
model_claims.source_quote: load_source was returning an empty `{}` instead of raising `IOError` when the `.py` config file is missing.

model_claims.text: load_source raises an IOError when the .py config file does not exist.
model_claims.source_quote: This PR fixes `load_source` to raise an `IOError` when the file does not exist

model_claims.text: Config._load_file treats a missing .py config file as an empty successful config and incorrectly sets `_found` to `True`.
model_claims.source_quote: This led to `Config._load_file` treating it as an empty successful config and incorrectly setting `_found` to `True` even when the file wasn't there.

model_claims.text: After the fix, Config._load_file correctly catches the IOError and marks `_found` as `False` for a missing .py config file.
model_claims.source_quote: This PR fixes `load_source` to raise an `IOError` when the file does not exist, allowing `_load_file` to correctly catch the exception and mark the file as not found.

model_claims.text: A test has been added to ensure `load_project()` marks `_project_found` as `False` when the file doesn't exist.
model_claims.source_quote: A test has been added to ensure `load_project()` marks `_project_found` as `False` when the file doesn't exist.

After the fix, Config._load_file correctly catches the IOError and marks `_found` as `False` for a missing .py config file.
A test has been added to ensure `load_project()` marks `_project_found` as `False` when the file doesn't exist.
